preset.rule: The sampled pages show a simple illustrated narrative with large images and very little text per page, which best matches a storybook.

renderStrategy.rule: The pages consistently use a prominent illustration on one side with a compact text block on the other, matching a story-oriented image-plus-text template.

pageGrouping.rule: The sampled pages read as independent page-by-page units and there is no evidence of artwork or text spanning across the gutter between facing pages.

sectioningMode.rule: Each sampled page functions as a self-contained narrative beat, with one scene and its accompanying text on each page.

activitiesGenerator.rule: The book is a narrative story with no detected exercises, prompts, or activity signals to convert into interactive elements.

figureExtraction.rule: The pages contain large illustrative scenes that are better represented as composite visual figures than as text alone, so selective composite extraction is appropriate.
